_comment: Query-count baselines for performance regression tests.
Each key is a test function name (without the test_ prefix).
queries  — maximum allowed query count (fail above this)
notes    — why this number, when it was last measured
2. If a test fails, the error message shows the actual count.
3. If the regression is intentional (e.g. new feature), update
the 'queries' value here and commit with the code change.
4. If unintentional, fix the N+1 or missing joinedload first.
Baselines set at ~50% headroom above measured values (2025-04-16).
Tight enough to catch N+1 regressions, loose enough to tolerate
minor data-shape variation across snapshot refreshes.

get_user_dashboard_data.notes: measured 26 (multi-project user) — primary target of ORM perf push

get_project_dashboard_data.notes: measured 45 — single-project path, many eager loads

get_fstree_data.notes: measured 3 — most expensive by wall time, few queries

get_allocation_summary.notes: measured 2 — heavy aggregation in single SQL

get_detailed_allocation_usage.notes: measured 37 — Project instance method, varies with allocation count

get_allocation_summary_with_usage_all_re.notes: measured 44 (18 resources, 4189 rows) — was 52,923 before Issue 1 fix

user_dashboard_route.notes: measured 70 — full GET /user/ including template render (benkirk). Count scales with benkirk's sampled project/allocation count, which varies per obfuscated-snapshot refresh (was measured 45 / baseline 65 before the 2026-07-11 refresh); extra headroom absorbs that variance without masking a real N+1 (which runs into the hundreds+).

allocations_index_route.notes: measured 55 — full GET /allocations/; was 52,923 before Issue 1 fix. show_usage toggle removed 2026-04-19 — usage pipeline now always runs (previously gated; measured 13 when gated off, 54 when gated on).

admin_orgs_card_route.notes: measured 20 — full GET /admin/htmx/organizations-card. Was measured 311 / baseline 450 until the Contracts tab moved to /admin/contracts (see admin_contracts_table_route); the 2,225-contract render was almost all of it.

admin_institutions_users_projects_route.notes: measured 130 — full GET /admin/htmx/institutions-fragment?show_users_projects=1; selectinload chunks × 1367 institutions × users × (led_projects + admin_projects)

get_institutions_with_members_include_pr.notes: measured 119 — function-level with include_projects=True; selectinload chunking across 1367 institutions

fstree_api_route.notes: measured 44 — full GET /api/v1/fstree_access/ (all resources); cached 5min in prod

resource_details_disk_route.notes: measured 34 (test snapshot, smallest disk-root subtree) post bulk_current_disk_usage refactor. Flat regardless of subtree size — was 83 on prod (NMMM0003, 21-node subtree) and scaled with node_count_with_account before the fix. ~50% headroom for snapshot variance.

project_detail_api_route.notes: measured 33 — full GET /api/v1/projects/<projcode> for the most-contract-bearing project (7 contracts). ProjectSchema.contracts serializes via ContractSummarySchema, which flattens 4 relationships per contract; _warm_contract_graph() preloads them. Discarding that helper's return value re-breaks it (weak-ref identity map) and measures 93 — this baseline is what catches that.

admin_contracts_table_route.notes: measured 25 — full GET /admin/htmx/contracts-table?active_only=1. Where the contract load lives since it moved off the organizations card; guards the selectinload/lazyload set in get_contracts_with_pi.

admin_expirations_expired_route.notes: measured 21 — full GET /admin/expirations?view=expired. Batched via get_projects_dashboard_data; count is near-flat in project count (selectinload chunks), so the old per-project path (~45 queries × N expired projects) regressing back runs into the hundreds+. Extra headroom absorbs expired-set size variance across snapshot refreshes.
